assumptions.surface: gray, isothermal; large surroundings enclosure at 23 C
assumptions.emissivities: 0.05, 0.2, 0.5, 0.9 sensitivity assumptions, not measured metal properties
assumptions.area: published illustrative 0.0012 m2; heat rates scale linearly with effective area
assumptions.nonlinear_remainder: difference from radiation approximated by a linear loss through ambient, matched at 50 C
assumptions.surface_temperature: scenario, not directly measured heater temperature; hotter cases are sensitivities
assumptions.comparison: hconv=5 scenario only; fitted Ua can already include linearized radiation
